opening.argument: The students describe educational support, graduation and post-secondary opportunities, not a deceptive offer. One says, “Thank you very much for your donations for helping. Me succeed through high school and on to post-secondary education,” while another identifies Pathways as “an amazing program to be part of and it helps a lot of students.” The closing frame reinforces that message with a “THANK YOU” alongside the RBC Foundation logo. Taken together, the testimony and closing frame present gratitude for support of an educational program, rather than a deceptive offer or solicitation.

citations.quote: Thank you very much for your donations for helping. Me succeed through high school and on to post-secondary education.
Pathways is an amazing program to be part of and it helps a lot of students.
